Container.Name: navigator-panel
Container.Overview:
Smart home, media and photo dashboard built specifically for the Cisco Room Navigator running RoomOS, in Persistent Web App mode.
Connects to Home Assistant over its WebSocket API for real-time entity state, and to Immich for a photo screensaver. All credentials stay in this container — the panel itself never receives them.
After starting: edit dashboard.yaml in the appdata folder to list your entities (a documented example is created for you on first run), then set the Navigator's Persistent Web App URL to:
http://[YOUR-UNRAID-IP]:8099/?t=YOUR_PANEL_TOKEN

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the panel is served on. This is the port you put in the Navigator's URL.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Holds dashboard.yaml, which lists your rooms, favourites, scenes and Immich albums. A documented example is created here on first run. Edit it and the panel updates within a second - no restart needed.

Config.Name: Panel Token
Config.Description: Shared secret the Navigator uses to authenticate. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32 Then provision the Navigator with http://YOUR-IP:8099/?t=THIS_VALUE Leave empty to disable authentication (bench testing only - anyone on your LAN could then control your house).

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Home Assistant, no trailing slash. Use an IP or a hostname your Unraid server can resolve. If HA runs in Docker on this same Unraid box, its container name works when both are on the same custom network.

Config.Name: Home Assistant Token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token. In Home Assistant: click your user name at the bottom of the sidebar, then Security, then Long-lived access tokens. Strongly recommended: create a dedicated non-admin user called 'panel' first and generate the token as that user, so it is independently revocable.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server, no trailing slash. Leave empty to disable photo features.

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich: Account Settings, then API Keys. Grant ONLY asset.read and album.read - no upload, no delete, no admin. Leave empty to disable photo features.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody' - leave this alone unless you know you need something else.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users' - leave this alone unless you know you need something else.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error. Use debug when troubleshooting a connection - tokens are redacted from logs at every level.

Config.Name: Unavailable Grace (ms)
Config.Description: How long Home Assistant may be unreachable before the panel stops showing last-known values and marks entities unavailable. Long enough to ride out an HA restart without the dashboard flickering.

Config.Name: Allow Self-Signed HA Certificate
Config.Description: Set to 1 only if Home Assistant uses a self-signed certificate you have not added to a trust store. Prefer fixing the certificate.
